title: CoreWeave高杠杆引关注 AI基建融资承压
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Catherine, you've been speaking to investors about Corrieve's situation and, you know, the biggest spike in yields really came after Corrieve's co-founder said the company wanted to get
segments.zh: 凯瑟琳，你一直在与市场参与者讨论Corrieve的情况，而收益率的最大飙升确实是在Corrieve联合创始人表示公司希望通过获得**级评级来获取“无限资金池”之后发生的。

segments.en: access to, quote, unlimited pools of capital by getting this investment grade rating as you alluded to earlier. Why was the suggestion that Corrieve would be borrowing more such a red flag?
segments.zh: 正如你之前提到的，为什么Corrieve将借更多钱的建议会被视为一个重大警示信号？

segments.en: Yeah, I think Corrieve's debt has grown into pace that is, you know, pretty extraordinary.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为Corrieve的债务增长速度非常惊人。

segments.en: Even among its AI infrastructure peers, where you're already dealing with a lot of, you know, borrowing, I think compared to its peers, it's materially more leveraged in some ways, at least
segments.zh: 即使在其人工智能基础设施同行中，这些同行已经面临大量借贷，我认为与同行相比，它在某些方面杠杆率明显更高，至少与一些公开的数据中心可比公司相比是这样。

segments.en: compared to some of the public data center comps. And it carries a pretty low interest coverage in the group. So I think that high leverage and then also a main distinction of Corrieve vids, it's
segments.zh: 而且它的利息覆盖率在同行中相当低。所以我认为高杠杆以及Corrieve的一个主要区别是，它依赖外部融资。

segments.en: dependent on outside financing. So unlike some of those heavy cash hyperscalers, like meta and Amazon, you know, it doesn't have a diversified business that's funding the AI investment internally.
segments.zh: 与Meta和亚马逊等现金充裕的超大规模公司不同，它没有多元化业务来内部资助人工智能**。

segments.en: So that's making it a lot more exposed to refinancing risk. And the thing about its tons of villains of debt is now also we're at a time of a higher interest rate environment which is going to
segments.zh: 这使得它更容易受到再融资风险的影响。而关于其大量债务的问题，现在我们还处于利率较高的环境，这将使借贷成本更加昂贵。

segments.en: make the cost of borrowing more expensive. So I think that's sort of compounding a lot of those investor concerns.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这加剧了市场参与者的许多担忧。
